{"script":"# Re-do steps 3 and 4 more carefully
echo "$var" > int_check_workspace/var_raw.txt
declare -p var > int_check_workspace/var_type.txt 2>&1 || echo "not set" > int_check_workspace/var_type.txt

# Step 5: Canonical numeric interpretation
# Use printf or bc to see if it's a number
if [[ "$var" =~ ^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then
    echo "$var" > int_check_workspace/var_numeric.txt
else
    echo "failure" > int_check_workspace/var_numeric.txt
fi

# Step 6: Extract fractional component
if [[ "$var" =~ \.([0-9]+)$ ]]; then
    echo "0.${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" > int_check_workspace/var_fraction.txt
else
    echo "0" > int_check_workspace/var_fraction.txt
fi

# Step 7: Create is_integer_candidate
# It's an integer candidate if numeric succeeded AND fraction is 0
NUMERIC=$(cat int_check_workspace/var_numeric.txt)
FRACTION=$(cat int_check_workspace/var_fraction.txt)
if [[ "$NUMERIC" != "failure" && "$FRACTION" == "0" ]]; then
    echo "true" > int_check_workspace/is_integer_candidate
else
    echo "false" > int_check_workspace/is_integer_candidate
fi

# Step 8: Cross-validate
echo "Validation log" > int_check_workspace/validation_log.txt
CANDIDATE=$(cat int_check_workspace/is_integer_candidate)
TYPE_INFO=$(cat int_check_workspace/var_type.txt)
echo "Candidate: $CANDIDATE, Type: $TYPE_INFO" >> int_check_workspace/validation_log.txt

# Show results
cat int_check_workspace/var_raw.txt
cat int_check_workspace/is_integer_candidate
"}
